## Specific task description

Task instruction: Direct the left arm to click the flat square gray switch

Task description: The target is the light-gray square switch to the left in the image, in front of the blue round bell. Use the left arm to press the small rectangular button on the front of the panel and toggle the switch.

Success criteria: The left arm presses the movable switch button to near the end of its toggle travel, reaching the completed switching position. Merely touching the panel or moving the button slightly does not count.

## Execution tips

- Narrow the left gripper appropriately and press one fingertip contact surface against the visible flat face of the small rectangular button, away from its edges. Avoid straddling the button with both fingers and only pressing the fixed panel.
- Approach from the front based on the panel's current tilt and push inward, reducing fingertip sliding across the button surface or contact with the panel frame.
- Make a small press to observe the button's actual movement direction, then adjust the contact point and complete its travel. Avoid continuing to push hard after it stops moving.
